name: qlrisk_initial_margin
title: Initial margin (ISDA SIMM)
description: Initial margin: method 'simm' (ISDA SIMM delta / vega / curvature by risk class), 'schedule' (BCBS-IOSCO grid, net-to-gross adjusted) or 'var'. One position gives its IM; several net into a portfolio IM. Each position needs notional, product_type and remaining_maturity; volatility, delta and sensitivities are optional. Example: {"method": "simm", "positions": [{"notional": 10000000, "product_type": "irs", "remaining_maturity": 5, "delta_sensitivities": {"5y": 4500}}]} gives Initial margin (simm): 252,000.00.
